content:
## Most overdue open work order

**WO-2026-00047** — Battery Tray Base Pan (formed), qty 120, 0 produced. Planned end 2026-02-25; it is **218 days past due** and still "stopped". (No cost has been recorded on this order: expected and actual are both 0, so there is no variance to report.)

## Why late

- **Blocking cause:** the subcontract **SCO-2026-00038** is still in draft and was never sent to the vendor (Rajendra Naik), so the outsourced work has no confirmed delivery (expected 2026-03-03, never committed). Until it is sent, no finish date can be committed.
- **Where it's stuck:** the very first operation, job card **JC-2026-00139 "Laser Cut Blank"** on LASER-01 Trumpf TruLaser 3030 — open, never started, waiting 227 days. All three job cards (JC-2026-00139/00140/00141) are untouched.
- **Contributing:** the order was stopped with no recorded reason; schedule shows subcontract pending; downtime was logged on the route — PB-02 Energy Mac 100T, 202 minutes for a spring steel quality issue (line 314, Aurangabad, accepted on concession), PB-01 Amada HFE 1303, 464 minutes (tool/setup changes), ASSY-01, 45 minutes.

## What it blocks

This is a make-to-stock order, so exposure is through BOM consumers (potential, not confirmed — stock may cover some demand):

- **Battery Tray Weldment orders that may need its output:** WO-2026-00116, WO-2026-00101, WO-2026-00086, WO-2026-00071 (in progress, urgent), WO-2026-00056 (in progress).
- **Downstream EV Battery Tray Assembly orders:** WO-2026-00106, WO-2026-00091, WO-2026-00076, WO-2026-00061.
- **Potential sales-order exposure, all Bharat EV Motors Ltd:** SO-2026-00151 (₹26,93,620.93, due 2026-06-10, undelivered), SO-2026-00171 (₹22,19,635.79, due 2026-07-12, undelivered), SO-2026-00021 (₹4,56,695.40, due 2026-08-18, undelivered), SO-2026-00050 (₹11,74,359.60, already delivered).

## Rescheduling

**Nothing could be rescheduled.** The proposal for WO-2026-00047 and every dependant returned "no committable date" because of the unsent subcontract — writable_by_seat=false for all, so writing new dates would mean inventing them. The unblock action is human: **purchasing must send subcontract SCO-2026-00038 to Rajendra Naik and get a committed delivery date**; once that exists, I can propose and apply new dates for the order and its dependants. No escalation channel is available from this seat, so please raise this with purchasing directly.

## Not visible to me

Nothing was withheld: the diagnosis and downstream walk listed nothing as outside this seat's view.
